Smoldyn particles in a consensus tissue

Composing CPM ⊕ vertex ⊕ munk (consensus boundary) ⊗ Smoldyn particles

A Smoldyn sim (A+B⇌C) runs inside each cell, confined to a boundary three tissue simulators agree on: vertex SHAPE, munk-consensus POSITION, CPM AREA. Molecules reflect off that composed boundary.
